title_en: What the Pit Keeps: The Safe Mark

commands.speaker: ac_tovin_reed
commands.text: The gust runs from the kiln to the pit. Watch the hanging cloth, not the dust at your feet.

commands.speaker: ac_mera_holt
commands.text: One spade has a child's height scratched into its shaft. A parent kept count.

commands.speaker: jori_flint
commands.text: Then keep the spade. Do not make the mark prettier.
